question: Which chapter concludes the section on Nagara and related rules in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text?
premises: It refers to the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text.
It names the twenty-fourth chapter on Nagara and related rules.
inference: This marks the end of the twenty-fourth chapter on the rules of Nagara and others in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, on the rules of Nagara and others, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
